Explicit valid-receipt/binding context and dynamics; no hidden future schedule
Same terminal certificates, unknown decisions and coverage as practical comparator
Costs include each full query bundle plus construction/update/proof/check overhead
limitations: Exact policy may be expensive; no practical efficiency result measured
This does not establish source/model fidelity or native leases
